user.title: Choose what to set up
user.description: Set up Codex assistants, Voice Match learning, or both as separate entries. Voice learning requires the Voice Match add-on, not a Codex account.

codex.title: Codex Assist
codex.description: Sign in with your ChatGPT/Codex account first. You will choose a chat model from your account’s model list after signing in.

voice_learning.title: Pair Voice Match learning
voice_learning.description: Enable the learning bridge in the add-on's administrator page. Enter its internal HTTP(S) origin and learning key here—not its personalisation key. This verifies pairing only; it does not grant recording consent. When reconfiguring, leave the key blank to keep the existing key.

learning_phone.title: Phone voice learning
learning_phone.description: Phone learning is off by default. To enable it, select your ordinary Wyoming Whisper source, not Voice Match's filtered or personalised endpoint. Afterwards, create a separate Voice Learning assistant using both new Voice Learning entities and your usual TTS. Do not change your default assistant. Each account must have its own assigned voice profile and give separate spoken consent.

device.title: Sign in with Codex

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in with Codex again
reauth_confirm.description: Codex Assist needs a fresh ChatGPT/Codex sign-in. Continue to request a new device code.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Codex Assist
reconfigure.description: Sign in again with your ChatGPT/Codex account. Your Codex Assist options will stay unchanged.

model.title: Choose a chat model
model.description: {model_status} Select the model used for Assist conversations and AI Task requests. Availability and feature support can vary by account.

abort.learning_requires_current_ha: Voice Match learning requires Home Assistant 2026.10 or later. Codex assistants remain available on this version.
abort.learning_reconfigure_required: Use Reconfigure on the Voice Match learning entry to repair its pairing. Codex sign-in is not used for learning.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Codex Assist was reconfigured and signed in again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not verify the learning bridge. Check its internal origin and learning key. Nothing has been recorded.
error.invalid_stt_source: Select an available ordinary Wyoming Whisper source with English support, not the learning entity.
error.authorization_pending: That code has not been approved yet. Finish signing in in your browser, wait a few seconds, then continue again.
error.device_code_auth_failed: Codex sign-in failed. Restart setup and try again.
error.device_code_request_failed: Could not request a Codex device code. Check network access from Home Assistant and try again.
error.invalid_model: Choose a model from the displayed list.
error.no_models: Your account returned no visible models. Try again later or restart setup with another account.

speaker_is.name: Recognised speaker is
speaker_is.description: Check the voice profile on this Voice Match sentence trigger. Recognition is not authentication.

voice.name: Voice profile ID
voice.description: Use the same profile ID from Manage voices in every automation. Uncertain or unrelated triggers never match.

voice_sentence.name: Voice Match sentence
voice_sentence.description: A literal sentence received by a paired Codex agent through the personalised Voice Match endpoint.

sentence.name: Sentences
sentence.description: Exact phrases, ignoring case, repeated whitespace and final sentence punctuation. No wildcards or templates.

abort.learning_requires_current_ha: Voice Match learning requires Home Assistant 2026.10 or later. Codex assistants remain available on this version.
abort.learning_reconfigure_required: Use the Voice Match learning entry's own configuration.

learning_phone.title: Phone voice learning
learning_phone.description: Enable only for a dedicated Voice Learning assistant. Use ordinary Wyoming Whisper, not a Voice Match endpoint. Disabling or reloading learning tries to pause its bound unfinished session; unverified cleanup needs attention. It does not delete saved samples or the installed voiceprint. Repair pairing with Reconfigure. Codex settings and your default assistant are unchanged.

voice_match.title: Voice Match personal preferences
voice_match.description: Optional pairing with Wyoming Voice Match. Create a key in its administrator page, paste it here, then use its personalised STT endpoint only with this integration. Leave the key blank to keep an existing pairing. Disabling removes this pairing. A matched voice changes response preferences, never Home Assistant permissions. Do not use shared speakers for confidential conversations.

settings.title: Shared AI Task defaults
settings.description:
{model_status}

These settings continue to apply to AI Task. Each conversation assistant has its own settings.

data_description.model: The model used for Assist conversations and AI Task requests.
data_description.text_verbosity: How concise or detailed normal text and voice responses should be.
data_description.web_search: Allow the model to search the web for current information. Search is off by default.

data_description.prompt: Default instructions used for AI Task requests. Conversation agents use their own individual system prompts.
data_description.reasoning_effort: How much reasoning supported models should use before answering.

data_description.image_model: Default quality for images created through Home Assistant AI Task.
data_description.image_size: Default shape and resolution for generated images.

agents.title: Conversation assistants
agents.description: Each assistant has its own personality, model settings, and conversation history. All assistants use this entry’s Codex sign-in and Home Assistant’s exposed-entity controls.

add_agent.title: Add assistant
add_agent.description: Choose a distinct name and personality. The assistant will appear as a conversation agent in Voice assistants.

remove_agent_confirm.title: Confirm assistant removal
remove_agent_confirm.description: Remove {agent_name} from this integration? Any Voice assistant pipeline using it will need another conversation agent.

error.invalid_stt_source: Select an available ordinary Wyoming Whisper source with English support, not the learning entity.
error.invalid_model: Choose a listed model or keep your saved model.
error.invalid_agent_name: Enter a name for this assistant.
error.agent_name_too_long: Keep the assistant name to 48 characters or fewer.
error.invalid_agent_prompt: Enter personality instructions for this assistant.
error.duplicate_agent_name: Each assistant must have a different name.
error.last_agent: Keep at least one conversation assistant.
error.invalid_voice_match_pairing_key: Paste a valid pairing key from the Voice Match administrator page.
